problem: Triangle ABC is scalene. Draw the three altitudes: AD from A perpendicular to BC, BE from B perpendicular to CA, and CF from C perpendicular to AB, where D, E, F are the feet of the altitudes on the respective sides. Mark the orthocenter H where the three altitudes meet.
In triangle ABC, let M, N, P be the midpoints of sides BC, CA, AB respectively. Draw the circle passing through M, N, and P, and mark its center J.

Triangle ABC is inscribed in a circle with center O. Draw the circumscribed circle, then draw the diameter starting at A and passing through O, meeting the circle again at the point D. Finally draw segments BD and CD.
In triangle ABC, draw the inscribed circle and mark its center I. Then mark the three contact points X, Y, Z where the incircle touches the sides BC, CA, AB respectively.
Two circles, one with center O and one with center P, intersect at two points M and N. Draw both circles, the common chord MN, and the segment OP joining the two centers.
Parallelogram ABCD has its two diagonals AC and BD meeting at point O. Let M be the midpoint of side AB. Draw the parallelogram, both diagonals, and the segment OM.
A circle has center O. From an external point P outside the circle, draw the two tangent lines to the circle, touching it at points S and T. Also draw segments PS and PT.
In triangle ABC, let M, N, P be the midpoints of sides BC, CA, AB respectively. Draw the three medians AM, BN, CP, and mark the centroid G where they intersect.
Triangle ABC has circumscribed circle with center O and orthocenter H. Let M be the midpoint of side BC. Draw the circumscribed circle, mark O, H and M, then reflect H over M to obtain the point K.
In triangle ABC, mark the centroid G, the orthocenter H, and the circumcenter O. Then draw the Euler line, the straight line passing through G, H and O.
